ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, registered agents, counterparties (sugar millers, refineries, vessel operators, charterers, and LC beneficiaries), and connected vessels against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Australian DFAT Consolidated List, New Zealand Sanctions Register, and Samoa's domestic terrorism list. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), both domestic and foreign, require enhanced due diligence, source of wealth and source of funds documentation, and senior management approval under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007. Adverse media and global watchlist checks must be completed prior to name reservation; any hit automatically escalates to the Samoa FIU for a written clearance opinion.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) - International Companies Registry (electronic lodgement exclusively through SIFA-licensed registered agents; no public self-service portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory name must be in Roman (Latin) script; Samoan and English names are accepted; Chinese characters and non-Latin scripts are not permitted in the legal name, and a transliterated English or Samoan rendering is mandatory; the name must end with the suffix 'International Company' or the abbreviation 'IC'; a dual foreign-language name may only be used if fully disclosed and transliterated in the registered constitutional documents.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any word implying patronage, sponsorship, or official connection with the Government of Samoa, a foreign government, or a head of state
Any identical or deceptively similar name to an existing Samoa or foreign registered company
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A valid name reservation may be extended once for a further 30 days on payment of the prescribed extension fee to SIFA. Upon rejection, the applicant or its licensed registered agent must file a written objection with the Registrar of International Companies within 21 days of the notice of refusal; the Registrar must issue a decision within 14 days. A further appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days of the Registrar's final decision. Alternatively, the applicant may submit a fresh name application after a 90-day cooling-off period. A name will not be released for registration of a competing entity while a timely objection or appeal is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only as the statutory registered office supplied by the licensed registered agent; the agent's physical address in Samoa must be maintained at all times. A Samoa International Company may not maintain a trading or operational office in Samoa, may not conduct business with Samoan residents, and may not acquire real property in Samoa; virtual operations for vessel shipment and sugar commodity arbitrage are permissible from any foreign jurisdiction.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified risk: approximately 5% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection for a low-risk wholesale commodity International Company; however, the licensed registered agent is subject to routine SIFA supervision and periodic AML/CFT on-site examinations, with a materially higher initial-year inspection risk of approximately 40% at the agent level.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2008 (Samoa), ss. 5-7 (incorporation), s. 8 (memorandum and articles), s. 10 (registered office), s. 14 (directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 – Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account requirement; subscriber must allot at least one share of no par value with nominal consideration paid in cash or as approved by the board
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed with the Registrar of International Companies are hereby adopted. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the subscriber's subscription of one ordinary share of no par value be accepted and allotted, and that the registered office located at the registered agent's address in Apia, Samoa be confirmed as the Company's registered office. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the named individuals be appointed as first director and corporate secretary, each authorised singly to open bank accounts, execute commercial shipping and trade documents, and instruct the registered agent for statutory filings. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the common seal, if adopted, be affixed to all instruments requiring sealing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Licensed Registered Agent and Conduct Name Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA-licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a SIFA-licensed agent to obtain a Certificate of Registration as International Company Agent and to submit a proposed corporate name (usually ending in 'Limited' or 'Ltd.') to SIFA for preliminary approval. The agent will file the name reservation request and confirm uniqueness in the International Companies register.
required_dossiers: Identification documents (passport) of ultimate beneficial owner
Brief statement of intended business purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, promptly submit two alternate names and, if reserved by another entity, obtain a written disclaimer of interest from the holder or select a distinct name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notarized execution before the registered agent or consular officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles using the SIFA standard form. The sole subscriber executes the instrument, with signature witnessed and notarized where required. The document must specify the registered office, share capital provisions, director provisions, and indemnity clauses in conformity with International Companies Act 2008.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association signed by subscriber
Consent of registered agent to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIFA issues a query on defective articles, the agent files an amended document or a corrective supplementary statement within 10 business days without re-paying the initial fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, SIFA, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the signed application package via the SIFA e-filing portal or in hard copy together with the prescribed filing fee. The application must identify the registered agent, registered office, subscriber shareholding, and first director. Payment is remitted by bank wire in US dollars to the SIFA official account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where SIFA queries beneficial ownership documentation, submit additional notarized identity evidence or a declaration of trust within 15 business days; failure to cure results in refusal with a right to re-apply after amendment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Certificate of Incorporation and Register Office Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, SIFA issues the Certificate of Incorporation setting out the company number and date of incorporation. The registered agent then opens the statutory registers, prepares share certificates, adopts the company seal (optional), and files the First Board Resolution with the company records.
required_dossiers: Registered agent confirmation of registered office
Share certificate and register of members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical errors, submit a request for administrative correction via the agent; SIFA will issue a confirmed Certificate within 5 business days at no extra statutory fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commence Trade Operations Under Incorporated Shield
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The board shall approve opening of settlement bank accounts, authorize revolving letters of credit and SWIFT wire operations, and adopt the transitional trade dossier for vessel shipment of VHP raw cane centrifugal sugar. The corporate books must reflect arm's-length agreements and maintain exemption from local tax under the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Certificates of good standing from SIFA if required by counterparty banks
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a counterparty bank demands additional corporate verification, obtain a Certificate of Good Standing and a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation from SIFA within 7 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa – not applicable for wholesale trading of raw cane sugar without manufacturing or warehousing
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory manufacturing or industrial operating license required for ISIC 4631 wholesale commodity trading activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category D (no EIA Report required) because the activity is non-manufacturing wholesale distribution conducted via chartered ocean freight without fixed installation, processing, or effluent discharge
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or solid waste discharge thresholds apply; the company must only ensure chartered vessels comply with MARPOL Annex V waste handling and ballast water documentation supplied by the shipowner

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification is not triggered for a low-risk registered office in Apia; no storage or processing premises are occupied, therefore no structural load inspection or workplace occupational clearance is required. Where the company later leases bonded warehousing, a Fire and Emergency Services Authority clearance certificate shall be procured prior to use.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MOR), Government of Samoa, headed by the Commissioner of Revenue; official portal: www.revenue.gov.ws; policy oversight by the Minister for Revenue.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: A licensed registered agent in Samoa incorporates the International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1987 through the Samoa International Finance Authority / corporate registry, obtaining the Certificate of Incorporation. Step 2: The registered agent files the TIN application (Form TR-1) with the MOR, attaching the Certificate of Incorporation, registered office address, and director/shareholder particulars; the MOR issues a company TIN within 3-5 business days. Step 3: VAGST registration is required only if the IC makes taxable supplies in Samoa exceeding WST 100,000 per rolling 12 months; an IC dealing exclusively in offshore cane sugar commodity trading (goods never landing in Samoa) is outside the scope of VAGST and may remain unregistered, or may voluntarily register solely to recover VAGST on local costs.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists under Samoan law. The IC is statutorily tax-exempt under the International Companies Act 1987 (exemption from income tax, VAGST on offshore-facing activities, stamp duty, and all other Samoan taxes and exchange controls), so no entity-classification election is required or available in respect of that exemption. An IC may, by special resolution, elect to redomicile or convert to a local company under the Companies Act 2006, thereby losing its exempt status and becoming subject to the Income Tax Act 2014; this election is irreversible except by reincorporation as a new IC. Samoa's Income Tax Act 2014 contains controlled-foreign-company rules and a general anti-avoidance provision addressing hybrid arrangements, but no formal hybrid-mismatch election is provided; where shareholders' home jurisdictions treat the IC as fiscally transparent, Samoan law applies a purely domestic legal-form characterization and does not recharacterize the exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) under the Goods and Services Tax Act 1992 (as consolidated in 2014), administered by the Ministry for Revenue.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 of taxable supplies in any rolling 12-month period (mandatory registration); voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control (CTC) regime, or digital tax stamp applies in Samoa as of the knowledge cutoff. Registered persons must file VAGST returns electronically via the MOR e-Services portal by the 28th day of the month following the end of the taxable period; monthly filing applies to all registered persons. Each taxable supply exceeding WST 100 must be documented by a tax invoice in the statutory form containing the supplier's VAGST registration number, invoice date, description, and tax amount. The MOR permits one-time bulk return uploads via API for large taxpayers; no per-invoice government clearance, digital stamping, or pre-approval is imposed.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Schedule 2 of the Goods and Services Tax Act 1992: (i) a supply of goods physically exported by the supplier from Samoa is zero-rated, provided the goods are removed from Samoa in the course of the supply and are not subsequently used locally; (ii) a supply of services to a non-resident recipient is zero-rated where the services are not physically performed in Samoa and are not directly in connection with land or goods situated in Samoa; (iii) international transport and freight services are zero-rated regardless of the supplier. For the WS_IC raw cane sugar arbitrage model (VHP raw cane centrifugal sugar shipped FOB/CIF from an origin port directly to a destination port with no physical presence in Samoa), the supply is outside the scope of Samoan VAGST because no part of the supply is made, utilized, or delivered in Samoa; consequently, no VAGST, zero-rating election, or refund procedure applies to the principal sale. If a sugar parcel is ever transhipped or warehoused in Samoa, the supply becomes zero-rated only upon proof of continuous export, evidenced by the customs export entry, through bill of lading, warehouse receipts, and discharge certificates. Input VAGST attributable to exported goods or outside-scope supplies is refundable only if the refund claim is filed within 12 months of the end of the taxable period and the supplier holds the complete documentary bundle listed below.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Samoa Customs Service export/submission entry)
Original or negotiable copy of the Bill of Lading plus mate's or tally receipt naming the IC as shipper
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank/forex statement proving receipt of export proceeds in a Samoan licensed commercial bank
Fully executed commodity sale contract together with the pro-forma and final commercial invoice
Independent polarization / SGS inspection certificate for raw cane sugar grading as contractually agreed
Certificate of Origin and shipping instruction/cargo manifest (where required by the importing jurisdiction)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Tax Administration Act 2014 imposes: (i) a shortfall penalty of 50% of the tax undercharged for failure to take reasonable care, and 150% for intentional disregard, fraud, or wilfully misleading statements; (ii) a late-payment penalty of 2% per month or part of a month on unpaid VAGST, capped at 100% of the tax; (iii) a late-filing penalty of WST 500 per month for registered persons, capped at WST 5,000; and (iv) interest at the gazetted MOR rate from the due date. The Commissioner may make retrospective assessments up to 5 years, extended to 10 years where fraud or wilful default is proven, and may claw back any VAGST refunded or credited with compound interest from the original refund date. Criminal prosecution for export zero-rating fraud, including false declarations, forged export documentation, or knowingly claiming refunds without physical export, renders the IC and its responsible officers liable on conviction to a fine of up to WST 200,000 and imprisonment of up to 3 years, plus forfeiture of the goods concerned. Exporters must retain the entire substantiation bundle for 10 years from the date of export; failure to produce records upon demand carries a separate penalty of WST 2,000 per failure. In practice, the MOR audits sugar and commodity traders under elevated scrutiny, applying substance tests to confirm that risk of loss and title passed offshore and that hard-currency proceeds were repatriated through a licensed Samoan commercial bank within the 180-day contractual/financing window.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), Apia — the statutory regulator of foreign exchange under the Exchange Control Act 1952, the Exchange Control Regulations 1952 (as amended), and the Financial Institutions Act 2016. All foreign-exchange transactions by residents must be executed through licensed authorized dealers, which are the CBS-approved commercial banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is a non-internationally traded currency under a managed float; current-account payments for merchandise trade are liberalized, while capital-account inflows and outflows (shareholder loans, repatriation of capital, portfolio movements) remain subject to CBS screening. A Samoa International Company holding a CBS exchange-control exemption certificate is treated as a non-resident offshore entity: it may hold, receive, and remit USD freely for sugar purchases, freight, charter hire and profit distribution without prior CBS approval and with zero tax leakage inside the Tax-Exempt Zone. The practical limitations are liquidity and correspondent access: the WST interbank market is shallow, USD clearing depends on ANZ Australia and BSP regional loops, and every capital movement must be evidenced by board resolutions and registered-agent confirmations to avoid triggering CBS reporting assumptions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For a non-exempt Samoa trading company, export proceeds from the physical shipment of VHP raw cane sugar must be repatriated to Samoa within three months from the bill-of-lading date, with 100% of the foreign exchange surrendered to an authorized dealer at the prevailing CBS-sanctioned rate unless a specific exemption is granted. A duly licensed International Company with an offshore exemption certificate is relieved of the mandatory conversion and surrender obligation; nevertheless, it must file the export declaration with the CBS for balance-of-payments statistical purposes and must maintain a complete invoice, bill-of-lading, and vessel documentation trail to sustain classification of the cargo as bona fide offshore trade rather than domestic export.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Account / Foreign-Currency Current Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific Samoa Limited (BSP Samoa)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and USD Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low for primary treasury rails. The Central Bank of Samoa does not license standalone electronic-money institutions or payment-institution platforms, and the Exchange Control Act requires all foreign-currency transactions to pass through licensed authorized dealers. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Currenxie and other multi-currency IBAN providers) cannot serve as the clearing bank of record for sugar-trade LC disbursements or vessel payments, and their use as a shadow USD treasury creates tri-party AML/CFT corroboration risk and CBS reporting gaps. Permissible deployment is strictly ancillary: EMIs may be used for executive expenses and minor overheads, provided the Samoa commercial bank is fully disclosed; the core USD liquidity must remain domiciled at ANZ Samoa or BSP Samoa.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for at least one first-signatory director at ANZ Samoa and BSP Samoa; remote video onboarding is not accepted for a non-resident offshore International Company unless the signatory appears in person at a bank branch in Apia or a designated regional office, or a CBS-licensed registered agent (trust company) executes the account mandate under a notarized power of attorney. Every director and every beneficial owner holding 25% or more must submit certified passport copies, proof of residential address, a banker's reference, corporate register extract, articles of incorporation, certificate of good standing, and the CBS exchange-control exemption certificate; the compliance officer conducts a fit-and-proper interview of the beneficial owner before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-owner tax-residency mismatch: a tax-resident Asian or Hong Kong owner of the Samoa IC with no operational staff, freight office, or commercial substance in Samoa.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified extract from the Samoa International Companies Office (SICO) register; CBS offshore/exchange-control exemption certificate; registered-agent certificate of good standing; beneficial-owner tax-residence certificate; audited financial statements; board resolutions delegating trade authority; commodity-trade mandate letter; and charter-party and broker correspondence trail evidencing the IC as the contractual principal of each sugar cargo.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or PEP linkage in the sugar supply chain: vessel IMO, chartering party, overseas seller, or consignee appearing on OFAC, EU, UN, or domestic PEP screening lists.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dated sanctions and PEP screening snapshots covering all counterparties, the vessel IMO number, ship manager, charterer, seller, and receivers; vessel flag certificate and P&I club certificate; single-voyage charter party with ISPS compliance clause; Lloyd's Register extract; and a signed undertaking to terminate exposure and freeze funds within 24 hours upon any negative list match.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party beneficiary and freight deviation: proceeds directed to an undisclosed supplier, broker, or freight-forwarder not named on the LC or original invoice.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original commercial invoice endorsed with the exporter's no-objection letter; LC clause expressly permitting third-party drafts; Intertek or SGS polarization (pol %) assay and certified weight certificates; endorsed bills of lading; marine cargo insurance certificate; and the ICC Uniform Customs and Practice (UCP 600) documentary-compliance checklist evidencing a clean presentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering indicators: the same VHP raw cane sugar cargo bought and sold on artificial margins, or repetitive round-trip routing through multiple jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent broker valuations of VHP raws for the relevant crop year; terminal and silo storage warrants; freight, demurrage, and despatch invoices; FOB/CIF contract schedules; the complete SWIFT MT103 payment chain of the re-sale; and an economic-substance narrative demonstrating that profit is computed on verifiable freight, insurance, polarization differentials, and delivery-timing spreads rather than circular flows.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Because the Samoa International Company has no statutory minimum capital, equity is subscribed or advanced through SWIFT MT103/MT202 transfers from the beneficial owner's home bank to the IC's USD account at ANZ Samoa or BSP Samoa via the Australian and New York correspondent corridors. Field 70 (Remittance Information) must carry the purpose identifier 'Capital Contribution / Shareholder Loan' or 'G301 – Trade in Goods' as applicable; concurrently, the IC files the CBS exchange-control exemption declaration, a board resolution authorizing the inward investment, source-of-wealth evidence, and the registered-agent confirmation of the updated shareholder register. Funds are released for trade disbursement only after cleared credit and after the Samoa bank's AML unit completes verification and assigns a compliant internal purpose code.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for VHP raw cane sugar rely on two clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 wires for clean payments, documentary collections, freight, and demurrage; and (ii) irrevocable sight or 60-day usance letters of credit issued by the counterparty's bank and advised or confirmed by a tier-1 bank in Singapore or London, with the Samoa bank acting strictly as advising bank. USD settlement is executed through the ANZ and BSP international correspondent loops (SWIFT to CHIPS/Fedwire via New York correspondents). Because Samoan commercial banks lack dedicated sugar-documentary credit desks, LC document examination, bill-of-exchange negotiation, and discrepancy handling are delegated downstream to the confirming bank under a back-to-back issuance framework, preserving the Samoa IC's riskless intermediary position in the physical sugar trade.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/WST deliverable currency forwards up to 12 months, executed through an authorized dealer with an underlying trade invoice and CBS exemption declaration
USD/WST non-deliverable forwards (NDF) booked on the Samoa bank's or its offshore head-office trading desk, cash-settled in USD with no physical WST conversion
USD/AUD and USD/NZD cross-currency swaps for freight, port, insurance, and financing-expense hedging, permitted for exempt International Companies with a CBS declaration
Vanilla USD/WST foreign-exchange options (puts and calls) with the authorized dealer, with premiums payable from the IC's USD operational account

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Renewal Fee Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation; payable annually on that date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a penalty of 10% per month or part thereof; continued non-payment for three months may lead to administrative strike-off and loss of separate legal personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registered Agent Confirmation of Registered Office and Register Location
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Registrar of International Companies (maintained at the registered office; filed by the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the renewal fee; within 30 days of the anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered office and agent may subject the company to non-compliance notices and eventual strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for International Companies; audit is voluntary and typically required only by lenders, directors' resolution, or the company's constitutive documents.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or a comparable framework may be adopted voluntarily; no mandatory filing of financial statements with the Registrar is imposed on International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: International Companies must keep a register of members, directors, and beneficial ownership information at the registered office; a UBO confirmation is updated upon any shareholding transfer, and the registered agent must ensure the UBO register is current at least annually to comply with Samoa's AML/CFT obligations.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,000 - US$5,000 (if voluntarily prepared and audited)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for an International Company (IC) on all non-Samoa-source income under the International Companies Act 1987, s.193; the general Samoa corporate income tax rate is 27% for assessable companies under the Income Tax Act 2012
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, and all other Samoan taxes for ICs transacting outside Samoa; exemption from exchange control on offshore accounts; no payroll tax on non-resident employees working exclusively outside Samoa

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR) filed electronically through the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) Online Portal at sifa.gov.ws; assessable companies file Form C (Company Income Tax Return) through the Samoa Ministry of Revenue e-Tax Portal at revenu.gov.ws
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: IC-AR must be filed within 90 days of the financial year-end (31 December for calendar-year filers), i.e., by 31 March; where an IC becomes assessable for Samoa-source income, Form C is due by 30 June following the tax year, with provisional tax instalments payable quarterly

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered corporate name, IC registration number, and date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact name registered with SIFA; foreign trade names are not acceptable

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Samoa and licensed registered agent details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the street address of the licensed IFS agent; PO Boxes are insufficient

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, shareholder register, and beneficial ownership particulars
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the register of members; each non-resident shareholder must supply a passport copy and proof of tax residence

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal business activity and declaration that no business is carried on within Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe offshore wholesale trading of raw cane sugar (ISIC 4631) with vessel shipment; state that contracting, shipping, and settlement occur wholly outside Samoa

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance declaration and IC tax-exemption confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm maintenance of records, agent relationship, and either Samoan substance or tax residence elsewhere; attach supporting documentation when requested by SIFA

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of IC-AR: fixed penalty of SAT 500 plus SAT 100 per day of continuing default, escalating to automatic strike-off by SIFA after 3 months; failure to file Form C attracts an immediate penalty of SAT 1,500, continuing monthly penalties of SAT 500, and interest of 1% per month on any unpaid tax

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders (exempt under the International Companies Act 1987, s.193); the general non-resident dividend withholding tax rate under the Income Tax Act 2012 is 15%
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: For IC distributions the exemption applies automatically and no treaty relief is required. For assessable non-resident shareholders claiming a lower treaty rate, the shareholder must (i) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the residence jurisdiction, (ii) submit the TRC with Form WHT-1 to the Samoa Ministry of Revenue, and (iii) deliver a certified copy to the Samoan payer before the distribution date; the payer must retain the certificate for 7 years; a refund path is available if the payer applied the statutory rate and the treaty entitlement is subsequently proven
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest and royalties paid by an International Company: 0% (IC exemption); general non-resident withholding tax on interest and royalty payments: 15% each; applicable double tax agreements (e.g., Samoa-New Zealand DTA) may reduce these rates to 10% on royalties and 10% on interest where the recipient is the treaty beneficial owner

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Samoa law prescribes no monetary TP documentation threshold; however, the Income Tax Act 2012 empowers the Commissioner to assess arm's-length pricing on any controlled cross-border transaction. Practical compliance benchmark for the sugar wholesale sector: prepare a Local File where annual related-party sales exceed WST 5,000,000 (approx. USD 1,850,000) and a Master File where global consolidated turnover exceeds WST 100,000,000
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa, as a member of the Global Forum and the BEPS Inclusive Framework, applies Economic Substance Regulations through SIFA and the International Companies Act 1987. An IC deriving trading or wholesale income must demonstrate either (a) real economic substance in Samoa (physical office, qualified staff, board management, core income-generating activities performed locally) or (b) tax residence and substantive activities in a foreign jurisdiction; bare-bone mailboxes without any substance declaration are subject to strike-off and reporting to the Samoan FIU

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Wilfully misstating or concealing Samoa-source income behind the IC shell; filing false IC economic substance declarations; backdating shipping or commodity contracts to distort the taxable year; refusing to provide records to the Ministry of Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Income Tax Act 2012: administrative penalty of 200% of the tax underpaid plus interest at 1% per month; criminal conviction punishable by a fine of up to SAT 500,000 (approx. USD 185,000) and imprisonment of up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are jointly and severally liable for restitution of the evaded tax; the Court may issue a travel ban and asset freezing order; a conviction carries custodial sentence with no eligibility for parole in offenses above SAT 200,000

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC with no physical office, employees, or business records in Samoa while routing large raw-sugar arbitrage settlement flows through Samoa accounts solely to obtain tax-exempt status; failing to file the IC annual return for more than one year
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and deregistration by SIFA; forfeiture of the IC name; a director of a deregistered company may be disqualified from managing any Samoan company for 5 years; reactivation requires the payment of all arrears, penalties (SAT 100 per day), and re-registration fees of SAT 2,500
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the corporate veil is pierced, directors incur personal liability for unpaid annual licensing fees, third-party trade debts, and consequential damages; the Central Bank of Samoa may ban the director from holding or controlling any Samoan licensed financial or trust institution

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Use of the IC as a staging vehicle for trade-based money laundering in the sugar commodity arbitrage chain, including false invoicing of vessel shipments, over- or under-invoicing against revolving letters of credit, phantom transport documents, and failure to disclose the beneficial owner to the Samoan FIU upon request
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (Samoa): a fine of up to SAT 1,000,000 and imprisonment of up to 10 years for money laundering; additional civil forfeiture of the entire proceeds of the offending transactions and freezing of related Swift wire transfers
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Prosecutors may indict directors as principals for laundering funds through the IC; personal assets are subject to confiscation orders; travel bans and surrender of passports are automatic while an anti-money laundering investigation is pending; directors face lifetime disqualification from regulated financial services
